scope: Load the installed reviewed pricing/coverage policy into the composition. W-WIRE deliberately shipped reviewedPolicy:null with no loader ('the user/root installs a reviewed policy capture later'); this packet adds exactly that loader, env-gated and fail-closed. protocol: withProductionComposition gains: options.reviewedPolicy ?? loadReviewedPolicyFromPath(env.PERABYTE_STUDIO_REVIEWED_POLICY_PATH). Resolution happens INSIDE withProductionComposition (per-composition, before the composer is built), never at import time.

loadReviewedPolicyFromPath(path: string|undefined): ReviewedPolicyInput|null — undefined path => null (today's behavior byte-for-byte); path set => readFileSync utf8, JSON.parse, parseReviewedQuotePolicy (the accepted strict parser in lib/production/proof-policy.ts). ANY failure (missing file, unreadable, malformed JSON, schema violation, hash mismatch, expired) => throw sanitized BUDGET_BLOCKED 'reviewed policy could not be loaded' — fail loud, never silently fall back to null when the operator asked for a policy.

No caching across compositions (fresh read per composition; the file is the operator's install act). No env reads at import time. No other behavior changes: provider factory, composer wiring, store lifecycle byte-identical.

Tests: (a) no env var => reviewedPolicy null (existing tests unchanged); (b) valid policy file => composer receives it and a bound quote composes end-to-end with the existing fixtures (reuse budget-composer test fixtures via the fake provider); (c) malformed file => BUDGET_BLOCKED with sanitized message, no partial composition; (d) file with tampered configCanonicalJson hash => BUDGET_BLOCKED; (e) expired policy file => BUDGET_BLOCKED.
